content.prompt:
Your manager, Ms Adaeze Okafor, wants to improve the staff break room at your company's office in Nairobi. She has asked you to write a short report for the management team about how the room is used now and what could be changed. Write your report (200-250 words). In your report you should:
- describe how staff currently use the break room and any problems with it
- suggest two changes that would make the room more useful or comfortable
- explain which change should be made first and why
